Draw the answer of an identification

Source: R/barcoding_plots.R
plot_barcoding_identification.Rd

Draws, from the tables the identification report writes, the answer per locus of an identification: for each locus found, the IdTaxa confidence at genus rank (striped bar) and at species rank (solid bar), coloured by state (1 species, 2 genus, 3 no answer), with the threshold as a dashed line. When the sampling table is given, the sampling of the named genera in the library (sequences per species and locus) is drawn below. The figure is the one of section 2 and section 6 of the report (report_barcoding_identification()), drawn without the library.

Usage

plot_barcoding_identification(
  answer,
  sampling = NULL,
  threshold = 60,
  max_species = 40L
)

Arguments

answer

Data frame or path. REPORT_<run_name>_answer.csv, or a table with its columns query, locus, compartment, state, predicted_species, predicted_genus, genus_confidence and species_confidence (reason, if present, leaves out the loci not found).

sampling

Data frame, path or NULL. REPORT_<run_name>_sampling.csv, or a table with its columns genus, species, locus and sequences; restricted to the genera named in answer.

threshold

Numeric. The IdTaxa threshold drawn as a dashed line. Defaults to 60.

max_species

Integer. Above this number of species in the sampling, the species not named are gathered into one row per genus, whose cells count the species with sequences at each locus. Defaults to 40.

Value

A ggplot object, or a patchwork object with the sampling below when sampling is given. Nothing is written.

See also

plot_barcoding_identification_summary(), report_barcoding_identification().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_barcoding_identification("11_barcoding/10_identify/REPORT_MN517611.1_answer.csv",
                              sampling = "11_barcoding/10_identify/REPORT_MN517611.1_sampling.csv")
} # }
